title: India proposes DEPA framework to unlock data for AI training
hook_text: India proposes DEPA for AI training
script:
India just proposed the DEPA framework to unlock data for AI training.
The proposal aims to make structured data accessible for developers building models.
Sharad Sharma co-founded iSPIRT, the think tank behind this data sharing model.
The initiative targets bulk de-identified data used to build models.
It utilizes secure data environments and differential privacy methods.
Electronic contracts govern access under the new policy setup.
Would you trust electronic contracts for training data?
